## Invitations

A total of 1472 people were invited to the River Districts outreach activity. Attendance was 33 people, representing a rate of 2.2 per cent. Participation remained limited in relation to the number of invitations issued.

Van days were maintained where road conditions allowed. This provided an available outreach option in areas that could be reached safely by road. The report records the activity and attendance for the period without attributing the low attendance to a specific cause.

## Contact

SMS contact was not used: the recorded number was 0. No reminders were sent, also recorded as 0. The absence of SMS messages and reminders meant that these contact methods did not contribute to follow-up with invitees.

Prepared by G. Evans.
